title: Add a visual purchase-order report field designer
description: User scene: from the purchase-order page, choose catalog fields and bounded supplier/date/status/currency filters and preview the current authorized purchase-order rows. The UI accepts only ERP-125's field catalog and never sends free-form SQL. Show unauthorized, empty, validation and network failures safely; previews remain read-only and covered by existing HTTP audit. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify Node UI logic tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Purchase-order page opens a field chooser and supplier/date/status/currency filters populated from ERP-125's finite catalog and existing supplier selector.
Preview sends only allowlisted columns and bounded filters, renders returned cells safely, and shows loading, empty, authorization and network states without writes.
Automated UI logic tests cover field selection, request limits, safe rendering and failure states; document the workflow and run Node syntax/test checks plus safe build/test.
